# eNI

> llms.txt for the eNI repository (embeddedos-org/eNI).
> Status: the Neural Interface Adapter — neural-signal
> acquisition and on-device inference for EmbeddedOS, under a
> formal security audit programme (issue #38).

eNI connects neural interfaces to EmbeddedOS: signal capture,
stimulation output with hardware safety limits, and on-device
inference over the signals. Its audit documents (scope, model
loading, stimulation output, tensor transport) are part of this
documentation set.
